Blackstone Gas Company files in compliance with the Letter Order of October 29, 2007, the following tariffs in connection with its third annual PBR filing: Residential Non-Heating Rate R-1, MDTE 80E, cancelling MDTE 80D; Residential Low Income Non-Heating Rate R-2, MDTE 81E, cancelling MDTE 81D; Residential Heating Rate R-3, MDTE 82E, cancelling MDTE 82D; Residential Low Income Heating Rate R-4, MDTE 83E, Cancelling MDTE, 83D; General Service Rate G-1 MDTE 84E, cancelling MDTE 84D; School Rate S-1, MDTE 85E, Cancelling MDTE 85D. By Andrew J. Newman. DPU 07-41
